title: A second home where curiosity comes first
text: We are a small, family-run centre for children aged 2 to 11. Our teachers know every child by name, celebrate small wins, and make learning feel like play.

highlights.title: Small, nurturing groups
highlights.text: Low child-to-teacher ratios so every child is seen, heard and encouraged.

highlights.title: Learning through play
highlights.text: Hands-on activities in language, maths and science that build confidence early.

highlights.title: Schedules that fit families
highlights.text: Weekday daycare, plus weekend and weeknight tuition around busy routines.
